svg.aria-label: The frame order, from demo lighting and atmosphere through the resolved linear HDR scene, the bloom pyramid, scene + strength * bloom, manual exposure with RGB gain and saturation, one tone curve and one sRGB encode, to the UI. The scene also feeds the sum directly, and the composite holds the four steps from the sum to the encode.
